name: Kingdom Hearts 358/2 Days Melon Mix
summary:
Kingdom Hearts 358/2 Days Melon Mix is a fan-developed project that enhances the original Nintendo DS title, Kingdom Hearts 358/2 Days, for a modern PC gameplay experience.

Utilizing a modified version of the melonDS emulator, Melon Mix refines the game by adapting its dual-screen interface into a single-screen display suitable for widescreen monitors. Key improvements include significantly upscaled graphics for a cleaner visual presentation, and reconfigured controls to support standard gamepads, notably enabling right-analog stick camera operation.
